name: Star And Cross
description: Zellige tilework: eight-pointed stars point to point, the cross-shaped spaces between them left open, each star holding a smaller star and a round hole.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--star); clip-path: @var(--star); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 16%, #000 16%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 16%, #000 16%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 25%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--star); clip-path: @var(--star); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 32%, #000 32%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 32%, #000 32%); -webkit-transform: rotate(22.5deg); transform: rotate(22.5deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
